items.title: 1.2 International System of Units (units ka aalmi system) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 1.2 with Tables 1.1 to 1.3 and the sixteen conventions (PDF 5-8).

blocks.text: 1960 mein ek international committee ne physical quantities ko describe (bayan) karne ke liye kuch definitions aur standards par agree kiya (mutafiq hui). Jo system bana use System International (SI) kehte hain.
SI units duniya bhar ke scientists aur taqreeban sab mulk istemal karte hain. SI mein do qism ke units hain: base units aur derived units.
